name: Building a life of prayer
promise: Six days from occasional prayer to a daily place with God.
why: For believers who want to pray but find it hard to start or to stay consistent. The path begins with why we were made to pray, then moves through giving yourself to prayer, finding your place, guarding your time and praying in the Spirit, and ends with the persistence that keeps knocking.

days.key_quote: Men ought always to pray, not to faint. You will never enter into that economy until you acknowledge the fact that you are insufficient.

days.theme: Give your whole self to prayer
days.key_quote: Prayer is who we are and not what we do.
It is when you arrive the point of prayer that you can begin to offer your prayer point.

days.theme: Shut the door and keep the time
days.key_quote: Shut the door is a serious business; it's not something that you can do double-minded.

days.theme: Build yourself up in the Spirit
days.key_quote: There are dimensions of believing that become possible when you gain heights in the Spirit.

days.theme: Keep knocking and do not faint
days.key_quote: The opposite of prayerful is not prayerless.
